description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/query_request.txt to extract the 5 番号 codes: ABF-328, JUR-067, MIDA-563, START-510, SSIS-592, and partial cast info. 2. Agent discovers the mock JAVDB server at http://localhost:7788 (via config/env/lookup.conf or by trying the JAVDB workflow from SKILL.md). 3. For each code, agent calls http://localhost:7788/search?q=<CODE>&f=all to get the video ID, then calls http://localhost:7788/v/<VID> to get cast, plot, studio, and magnet data. 4. Agent infers studios from the SKILL.md prefix table (ABF→Prestige, JUR→Madonna, MIDA→MOODYZ, START→SOD Create, SSIS→S1 No.1 Style). 5. Agent filters magnets for -c (Chinese subtitle) versions: ABF-328-C, MIDA-563-C (or MIDA-563-UC for bonus), SSIS-592-C — prioritizing these larger files. 6. For JUR-067 and START-510 which have no -c version, agent annotates '暫無特殊版本' per SKILL.md rules. 7. All plot summaries must be in Traditional Chinese (not Simplified), 20-50 characters. 8. Magnet links must follow format magnet:?xt=urn:btih:<HASH>&dn=<filename>. 9. Output saved as lookup_report.md with columns: #, 番號, 主演, 片商, 一句話劇情, 磁力鏈接, 備注.
